rows.label: Prisma Shade
rows.note: arrives built, no blueprint or foundry step

rows.label: free Companion Slot
rows.note: one for Prisma Shade, one for its Prisma Burst Laser

conditions: Without two free Companion slots the purchase fails.
Baro's stock changes each visit, so it may be missing on the next one.
bonuses: The purchase includes the Prisma Burst Laser, a separate Mastery item, already built.

disclosures.title: level both for full Mastery
disclosures.body: Prisma Shade and the Prisma Burst Laser are separate Mastery items. The Burst Laser levels while equipped on the Sentinel.

disclosures.title: other routes
disclosures.body: During TennoCon, Baro's special Relay is open to anyone with a ticket and stocks Prisma Shade. Unranked copies without Forma or Orokin Reactor also trade between players.
